description: Simplex compiler core. The self-hosted compiler toolchain including lexer, parser, code generator, and standard library bindings. Written in Simplex, bootstrapped via stage0.py.

modules.name: main
modules.description: Compiler entry point. Parses command-line arguments and orchestrates the compilation pipeline.

modules.name: lexer
modules.description: Lexical analyzer. Converts source text into a stream of tokens (identifiers, keywords, operators, literals, etc.).

items.name: TokenKind
items.signature: enum TokenKind { Eof, Ident, Int, String, Float, ... }

modules.name: parser
modules.description: Recursive descent parser. Converts token stream into an AST using the tag-based AST representation defined in lib/ast_defs.sx.

modules.name: codegen
modules.description: LLVM IR code generator. Walks the AST and emits LLVM IR text for compilation to native code.

modules.name: stdlib
modules.description: Standard library bindings for the compiler. Provides the built-in functions and types available in every Simplex program.

modules.name: compiler
modules.description: Combined compiler module used by the single-file combined.sx compiler. Contains TokenKind and other shared definitions.

items.name: TokenKind
items.signature: enum TokenKind { Eof, Ident, Int, String, LParen, RParen, LBrace, RBrace, ... }
